text: The cafeteria should introduce the plant-based menu. The nutritionist-reviewed rotation meets every nutritional requirement, ensuring that the food meets the dietary needs of all students. A live fermentation station is a crucial feature, as it guarantees freshness and quality of the ingredients used. Additionally, the new equipment is expected to save resources over time, reducing costs and environmental impact. The seasonal produce contract savings also offset the initial investment, indicating a reliable and safe food system. In light of these factors, the plant-based menu is a compelling choice for the cafeteria.
